# orbital-earth

> Web-based 3D interactive globe built with React (Vite) and CesiumJS. Search any place with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, fly the camera there, read live lat/lon/altitude telemetry, click the globe to identify a point, and share the camera view as a URL. Runs without an API key; an optional free Cesium ion token adds photoreal satellite imagery and 3D terrain.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/puIad/orbital-earth/blob/main/README.md): setup, features, how the Cesium and Vite wiring works

## Source

- [src/components/EarthViewer.jsx](https://github.com/puIad/orbital-earth/blob/main/src/components/EarthViewer.jsx): globe and camera
- [src/components/SearchBar.jsx](https://github.com/puIad/orbital-earth/blob/main/src/components/SearchBar.jsx): geocoding search
- [src/lib/nominatim.js](https://github.com/puIad/orbital-earth/blob/main/src/lib/nominatim.js): Nominatim client
- [src/lib/cameraUrl.js](https://github.com/puIad/orbital-earth/blob/main/src/lib/cameraUrl.js): shareable camera URL
